author: irareup

title: Brilliant app with the right amount of features
body: The Google Keep app is absolutely fantastic and is perfect if you use it as a notes app. It has enough features for lists and filtering notes with tags, add photos or quick hand written pieces. I find myself starting with an idea in notes and it stays there for a while until i need more features, or I’m working on the note more, then i just export to “Docs” in a few seconds. You use it much like a real notepad. You can see all your notes/pages and you can quickly check something or add more information. Highly useful if used the way its intended. Would be extremely disappointed if Keep becomes discontinued due to criticisms that are unfair.
author: harsh and honest

title: Quick and easy to use
body:
Very simple to use and easy to customise using labels. I use Keep for simple note taking and ToDo lists; using customised labels I can categorise them to produce different filter views.

The following issue seems to have been fixed quite promptly so I give it 5 stars

The formatting and font is off after the previous update. When editing a checkbox list the space between the next checkbox item reduces to the point where the text will overlap so it becomes impossible to read the text on either line.

I really like google keep but this is making it awkward to use because I have to close the checkbox list to reset the view and the spacing. For me this only seems to happen when I am editing a checkbox list.
